title: Detroit City Highlights Walking Tour Downtown Landmarks
blurb: Discover the heart of Detroit on this City Highlights Walking Tour through downtown’s most iconic landmarks, historic districts, and architectural treasures. Explore the city’s rich past, from its industrial rise and labor history to its modern revival and cultural energy. Walk through vibrant public spaces, admire world-famous Art Deco buildings, and hear stories of Detroit’s legends, resilience, and transformation. This guided experience offers the perfect introduction to the city’s history, culture, and hidden gems.
